# Context Menu

The actions menu that opens where you right-click. Built on Radix ContextMenu for keyboard navigation and a11y; it shares its surface and density with Dropdown Menu, but anchors to the cursor.

```tsx
<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuTrigger asChild>
    <Card className="w-72 cursor-default select-none transition-shadow hover:shadow-md">
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-purple/10 text-purple">
            <FolderOpen className="size-5" />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <CardTitle className="text-base">Q3 Marketing Plan</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Edited 2 hours ago · 14 files</CardDescription>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Right-click to open the menu</p>
      </CardHeader>
    </Card>
  </ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ContextMenuContent className="w-56">
    <ContextMenuItem>
      <FolderOpen /> Open
      <ContextMenuShortcut>⏎</ContextMenuShortcut>
    </ContextMenuItem>
    <ContextMenuItem>
      <PencilSimple /> Rename
      <ContextMenuShortcut>⌘R</ContextMenuShortcut>
    </ContextMenuItem>
    <ContextMenuItem>
      <Copy /> Duplicate
      <ContextMenuShortcut>⌘D</ContextMenuShortcut>
    </ContextMenuItem>
    <ContextMenuSeparator />
    <ContextMenuItem>
      <PushPin /> Pin to top
    </ContextMenuItem>
    <ContextMenuSub>
      <ContextMenuSubTrigger>
        <ShareNetwork /> Share
      </ContextMenuSubTrigger>
      <ContextMenuSubContent className="w-44">
        <ContextMenuItem>
          <Envelope /> Email
        </ContextMenuItem>
        <ContextMenuItem>
          <Link /> Copy link
          <ContextMenuShortcut>⌘L</ContextMenuShortcut>
        </ContextMenuItem>
        <ContextMenuSeparator />
        <ContextMenuItem>
          <ChatCircle /> Send message
        </ContextMenuItem>
      </ContextMenuSubContent>
    </ContextMenuSub>
    <ContextMenuSeparator />
    <ContextMenuItem variant="destructive">
      <Trash /> Delete
      <ContextMenuShortcut>⌫</ContextMenuShortcut>
    </ContextMenuItem>
  </ContextMenuContent>
</ContextMenu>
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli@latest init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli@latest add context-menu
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/context-menu/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
import {
  ContextMenu, ContextMenuTrigger, ContextMenuContent,
  ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuShortcut,
} from "@/components/ui/context-menu"
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Copy, PencilSimple, Trash } from "@phosphor-icons/react"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ContextMenu>
      <ContextMenuTrigger asChild>
        <Card className="w-72 select-none p-6">Right-click me</Card>
      </ContextMenuTrigger>
      <ContextMenuContent className="w-48">
        <ContextMenuItem>
          <PencilSimple /> Rename
          <ContextMenuShortcut>⌘R</ContextMenuShortcut>
        </ContextMenuItem>
        <ContextMenuItem>
          <Copy /> Duplicate
          <ContextMenuShortcut>⌘D</ContextMenuShortcut>
        </ContextMenuItem>
        <ContextMenuSeparator />
        <ContextMenuItem variant="destructive">
          <Trash /> Delete
        </ContextMenuItem>
      </ContextMenuContent>
    </ContextMenu>
  )
}
```

## Any surface as the trigger

Wrap any element with `ContextMenuTrigger` and `asChild`; the menu opens at the cursor anywhere inside it. An image is the classic right-click target.

```tsx
<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuTrigger asChild>
    <figure className="aspect-[3/2] w-72 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border shadow-xs">
      <img src="/landscape.jpg" alt="Mountain landscape" className="size-full object-cover" />
    </figure>
  </ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ContextMenuContent className="w-52">
    <ContextMenuItem>
      <CornersOut /> Open full size
    </ContextMenuItem>
    <ContextMenuItem>
      <ImageSquare /> Copy image
      <ContextMenuShortcut>⌘C</ContextMenuShortcut>
    </ContextMenuItem>
    <ContextMenuItem>
      <Link /> Copy image address
    </ContextMenuItem>
    <ContextMenuSeparator />
    <ContextMenuItem>
      <DownloadSimple /> Save image
      <ContextMenuShortcut>⌘S</ContextMenuShortcut>
    </ContextMenuItem>
    <ContextMenuItem>
      <Star /> Add to favorites
    </ContextMenuItem>
  </ContextMenuContent>
</ContextMenu>
```

## Checkbox items

Toggle independent options straight from the menu. `ContextMenuCheckboxItem` closes the menu when toggled, like any row; pass `closeOnSelect={false}` to flip several in one pass.

```tsx
<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuTrigger asChild>
    <div className="flex h-40 w-72 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed">
      Right-click the canvas
    </div>
  </ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ContextMenuContent className="w-52">
    <ContextMenuLabel>View</ContextMenuLabel>
    <ContextMenuSeparator />
    <ContextMenuCheckboxItem checked>Show grid</ContextMenuCheckboxItem>
    <ContextMenuCheckboxItem checked>Snap to grid</ContextMenuCheckboxItem>
    <ContextMenuCheckboxItem>Rulers</ContextMenuCheckboxItem>
    <ContextMenuCheckboxItem>Pixel preview</ContextMenuCheckboxItem>
  </ContextMenuContent>
</ContextMenu>
```

## Switch items

Pass `variant="switch"` to a checkbox item for an option that applies the moment it flips. The menu stays open when it is toggled, so a few can be set before it closes; the row is still a menu checkbox, with the switch as its drawing.

```tsx
<ContextMenuContent className="w-56">
  <ContextMenuLabel>View</ContextMenuLabel>
  <ContextMenuSeparator />
  <ContextMenuCheckboxItem variant="switch" checked={grid} onCheckedChange={setGrid}>
    <GridFour /> Show grid
  </ContextMenuCheckboxItem>
  <ContextMenuCheckboxItem variant="switch" checked={snap} onCheckedChange={setSnap}>
    <Magnet /> Snap to grid
  </ContextMenuCheckboxItem>
</ContextMenuContent>
```

## Radio items

A mutually exclusive choice lives in a `ContextMenuRadioGroup` with a shared `value`; the active row shows a check.

```tsx
<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuTrigger asChild>
    <div className="flex h-40 w-72 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed">
      Right-click to sort
    </div>
  </ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ContextMenuContent className="w-48">
    <ContextMenuLabel>Sort by</ContextMenuLabel>
    <ContextMenuSeparator />
    <ContextMenuRadioGroup value="modified">
      <ContextMenuRadioItem value="name">
        <TextAa /> Name
      </ContextMenuRadioItem>
      <ContextMenuRadioItem value="modified">
        <PencilSimple /> Last modified
      </ContextMenuRadioItem>
      <ContextMenuRadioItem value="size">
        <ArrowsOutCardinal /> Size
      </ContextMenuRadioItem>
    </ContextMenuRadioGroup>
  </ContextMenuContent>
</ContextMenu>
```

## Groups, submenus & shortcuts

Section items with `ContextMenuGroup`, nest a `ContextMenuSub`, and add right-aligned hints with `ContextMenuShortcut` (decorative; wire the real binding in your app). Use `inset` to align items that have no leading icon.

```tsx
<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuTrigger asChild>
    <div className="flex h-40 w-72 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed">
      Right-click the editor
    </div>
  </ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ContextMenuContent className="w-56">
    <ContextMenuGroup>
      <ContextMenuItem>
        <Copy /> Copy
        <ContextMenuShortcut>⌘C</ContextMenuShortcut>
      </ContextMenuItem>
      <ContextMenuItem>
        <PencilSimple /> Cut
        <ContextMenuShortcut>⌘X</ContextMenuShortcut>
      </ContextMenuItem>
      <ContextMenuItem inset>
        Paste
        <ContextMenuShortcut>⌘V</ContextMenuShortcut>
      </ContextMenuItem>
    </ContextMenuGroup>
    <ContextMenuSeparator />
    <ContextMenuSub>
      <ContextMenuSubTrigger>
        <ShareNetwork /> Share
      </ContextMenuSubTrigger>
      <ContextMenuSubContent className="w-44">
        <ContextMenuItem>
          <Envelope /> Email link
        </ContextMenuItem>
        <ContextMenuItem>
          <Link /> Copy link
          <ContextMenuShortcut>⌘L</ContextMenuShortcut>
        </ContextMenuItem>
        <ContextMenuSeparator />
        <ContextMenuItem>
          <ChatCircle /> Messages
        </ContextMenuItem>
      </ContextMenuSubContent>
    </ContextMenuSub>
    <ContextMenuSeparator />
    <ContextMenuItem variant="destructive">
      <Trash /> Delete
      <ContextMenuShortcut>⌫</ContextMenuShortcut>
    </ContextMenuItem>
  </ContextMenuContent>
</ContextMenu>
```

## API reference

### ContextMenu

The root, Radix `ContextMenu.Root`; renders no DOM. Every part that renders an element accepts `className`, merged last.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onOpenChange | (open: boolean) => void | - | Called when the menu opens or closes. A context menu has no controlled `open`: the gesture opens it. |
| modal | boolean | true | Block outside pointer interaction and hide the rest of the page from screen readers while open. |
| dir | "ltr" \| "rtl" | - | Reading direction for keyboard navigation and submenu placement. |

### ContextMenuTrigger

The area that opens the menu on right-click or long-press, Radix `ContextMenu.Trigger`. Renders a `<span>` and forwards all its props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | boolean | false | Merge onto your own element (a Card, a figure, a row) instead of rendering a `<span>`. |
| disabled | boolean | false | Let the native browser context menu open instead. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"open"` or `"closed"`. |
| data-disabled | Present when disabled. |

### ContextMenuContent

The menu, Radix `ContextMenu.Content` portalled to the body and anchored to the cursor; forwards all its props. Declares `--surface`, so a nested control blends with the menu.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height for every row inside, 36px or 32px. Unset, the rows follow the nearest `DensityProvider`. |
| updatePositionStrategy | "optimized" \| "always" | "always" | `always` re-anchors an open menu to each new right-click point; `optimized` only re-measures on scroll and resize. |
| collisionPadding | number | 8 | Distance in pixels kept from the viewport edge; also shrinks the width the menu is capped at. |
| alignOffset | number | 0 | Offset in pixels from the cursor along the alignment axis. |
| avoidCollisions | boolean | true | Flip and shift to stay on screen. |
| loop | boolean | false | Wrap keyboard focus from the last row to the first. |
| onCloseAutoFocus | (event: Event) => void | - | Called as focus returns on close; `preventDefault()` to keep it elsewhere. |
| onEscapeKeyDown | (event: KeyboardEvent) => void | - | Called on Escape; `preventDefault()` to keep the menu open. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"open"` or `"closed"`. |
| data-side | The side of the cursor the menu opened on, after collisions. |
| data-align | `"start"`, `"center"` or `"end"`. |

| CSS variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --radix-popper-transform-origin | The cursor-side origin the menu grows from. |
| --radix-context-menu-content-available-width | Width left beside the cursor; the menu's `max-width`. |
| --radix-context-menu-content-available-height | Height left between the cursor and the viewport edge. |
| --surface | Set to `var(--popover)`, read by nested Inputs and Selects. |

### ContextMenuItem

One action row, Radix `ContextMenu.Item`; forwards all its props. A leading Phosphor icon is muted and sized to 20px.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | "default" \| "destructive" | "default" | `destructive` colours the label, icon and highlight red. |
| inset | boolean | false | Indent the label to line up with siblings that lead with an icon. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height, 36px or 32px. Falls back to the menu's `density`, then the nearest `DensityProvider`. |
| disabled | boolean | false | Skip the row in keyboard navigation and ignore clicks. |
| onSelect | (event: Event) => void | - | Called when the row is chosen; `preventDefault()` to keep the menu open. |
| textValue | string | - | Text used for typeahead when the row's content is not plain text. |
| asChild | boolean | false | Merge onto your own element, such as a link. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-highlighted | Present while the row has keyboard or pointer focus. |
| data-disabled | Present when the row is disabled. |
| data-inset | Present when `inset` is set. |

### ContextMenuCheckboxItem

A toggle row, Radix `ContextMenu.CheckboxItem` (`menuitemcheckbox`); forwards all its props. Shows a brand check on the right, or a mini Switch.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| checked | boolean \| "indeterminate" | - | The checked state. |
| onCheckedChange | (checked: boolean) => void | - | Called when the row is toggled. |
| variant | "check" \| "switch" | "check" | How the state reads: the check, or a Switch drawing for a setting that applies the moment it flips. |
| closeOnSelect | boolean | true | Close the menu when the row is toggled. Defaults to `false` for `variant="switch"`. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height, 36px or 32px. Falls back to the menu's `density`, then the nearest `DensityProvider`. |
| disabled | boolean | false | Skip the row and ignore clicks. |
| onSelect | (event: Event) => void | - | Called when the row is chosen. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"checked"`, `"unchecked"` or `"indeterminate"`. |
| data-highlighted | Present while the row has keyboard or pointer focus. |
| data-disabled | Present when the row is disabled. |

### ContextMenuRadioGroup

Holds one exclusive choice, Radix `ContextMenu.RadioGroup`. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | string | - | The selected item's value. |
| onValueChange | (value: string) => void | - | Called when another item is chosen. |

### ContextMenuRadioItem

One option in a radio group, Radix `ContextMenu.RadioItem` (`menuitemradio`); the selected row shows the same brand check as a checkbox row.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value* | string | - | The value this row selects. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height, 36px or 32px. Falls back to the menu's `density`, then the nearest `DensityProvider`. |
| disabled | boolean | false | Skip the row and ignore clicks. |
| onSelect | (event: Event) => void | - | Called when the row is chosen; `preventDefault()` to keep the menu open. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"checked"` or `"unchecked"`. |
| data-highlighted | Present while the row has keyboard or pointer focus. |
| data-disabled | Present when the row is disabled. |

### ContextMenuLabel

A small muted section heading, Radix `ContextMenu.Label`; not focusable. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| inset | boolean | false | Indent to line up with rows that lead with an icon. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height, 36px or 32px. Falls back to the menu's `density`, then the nearest `DensityProvider`. |

### ContextMenuSeparator

A hairline between sections, Radix `ContextMenu.Separator`, stopping at the menu's ring. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height, 36px or 32px. Falls back to the menu's `density`, then the nearest `DensityProvider`. |

### ContextMenuGroup

Groups related rows for assistive tech, Radix `ContextMenu.Group`; unstyled. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

### ContextMenuShortcut

A right-aligned shortcut hint, Koala's `Kbd` at `size="sm"`; decorative, it binds nothing. Forwards all `Kbd` props.

### ContextMenuSub

The root of a nested menu, Radix `ContextMenu.Sub`; renders no DOM.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open | boolean | - | Controlled open state. |
| defaultOpen | boolean | false | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| onOpenChange | (open: boolean) => void | - | Called when the submenu opens or closes. |

### ContextMenuSubTrigger

The row that opens a submenu, Radix `ContextMenu.SubTrigger`, with a caret on the right; forwards all its props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| inset | boolean | false | Indent to line up with rows that lead with an icon. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height, 36px or 32px. Falls back to the menu's `density`, then the nearest `DensityProvider`. |
| disabled | boolean | false | Skip the row and keep the submenu closed. |
| textValue | string | - | Text used for typeahead when the row's content is not plain text. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"open"` or `"closed"`. |
| data-highlighted | Present while the row has keyboard or pointer focus. |
| data-disabled | Present when the row is disabled. |

### ContextMenuSubContent

The nested menu, Radix `ContextMenu.SubContent`; same surface as the content, and it animates out on close. Forwards all its props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height, 36px or 32px. Falls back to the menu's `density`, then the nearest `DensityProvider`. |
| sideOffset | number | 0 | Gap in pixels between the trigger row and the submenu. |
| alignOffset | number | 0 | Offset in pixels along the alignment axis. |
| collisionPadding | number | 0 | Distance in pixels kept from the viewport edge. |
| loop | boolean | false | Wrap keyboard focus from the last row to the first. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"open"` or `"closed"`. |
| data-side | The side the submenu opened on, after collisions. |
| data-align | `"start"`, `"center"` or `"end"`. |

| CSS variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --radix-popper-transform-origin | The trigger-side origin the submenu grows from. |

### ContextMenuPortal

Radix `ContextMenu.Portal`. `ContextMenuContent` already portals itself, so you rarely need it.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| container | HTMLElement \| null | document.body | Where to portal the content. |

## FAQ

### When should I use a Context Menu versus a Dropdown Menu?

They share the same surface and items; the difference is how they open. A Dropdown Menu opens on click of a visible trigger button, so the affordance is obvious. A Context Menu opens on right-click (or long-press) of an arbitrary area like a card, row, image, or canvas, so it is best for secondary or power-user actions that should not take up button space. Many apps offer both: a more-actions button and the same actions on right-click.

### How do I make a card or any element the trigger?

Pass `asChild` to ContextMenuTrigger and render your element inside it, such as a Card or a figure. Radix attaches the right-click handler and ARIA to your element instead of rendering its own wrapper, and the menu anchors to the cursor position within it.

### Why doesn't ContextMenuContent take a `side` or `sideOffset`?

A context menu is positioned at the cursor where you right-clicked, not relative to a trigger element, so there is no side or gap to offset. Radix still flips the menu to stay on-screen and sets `data-side`, and the menu fades and scales in from the cursor point.

### Does ContextMenuShortcut bind the keyboard shortcut?

No. ContextMenuShortcut is purely decorative right-aligned text rendered through the shared Kbd primitive, so it just displays the hint like ⌘R. Wire up the real key binding in your app with a global listener.

### How does it behave on touch devices?

Radix opens the menu on long-press, the platform convention for touch. Keep the right-click actions reachable another way too (a more-actions button) since not every user will discover the long-press gesture.

### How do I change the menu's density?

Rows are `compact` (32px) by default. For 36px rows, set `density="comfortable"` on ContextMenuContent and every row inside follows, sub-menus included. Without it, rows follow the nearest DensityProvider. A row's own `density` still wins, for a one-off. Icons, labels, shortcuts and the check sit 16px from the edge at either size, and the corners stay concentric.

## Exports and dependencies

`npx koalaui-cli@latest add context-menu` writes `components/ui/context-menu/`. Import from `@/components/ui/context-menu`:

- Components and helpers: `ContextMenu`, `ContextMenuTrigger`, `ContextMenuGroup`, `ContextMenuRadioGroup`, `ContextMenuSub`, `ContextMenuPortal`, `ContextMenuContent`, `ContextMenuItem`, `ContextMenuCheckboxItem`, `ContextMenuRadioItem`, `ContextMenuLabel`, `ContextMenuSeparator`, `ContextMenuShortcut`, `ContextMenuSubTrigger`, `ContextMenuSubContent`, `contextMenuVariants`
- Types: `ContextMenuContentProps`, `ContextMenuItemProps`, `ContextMenuCheckboxItemProps`, `ContextMenuRadioItemProps`, `ContextMenuLabelProps`, `ContextMenuSubTriggerProps`, `ContextMenuSubContentProps`
- Koala components it installs with it: `kbd`, `switch`
- Koala lib helpers it uses: `density`, `tv`, `utils`
- npm packages: `@phosphor-icons/react`, `radix-ui`
